# read_pickle { #cflowdist.read_pickle }

```python
read_pickle(filename, dir_config='./config/default.json')
```

Read a CarbonTracer object from a pickle file.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                      | Default                   |
|------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| filename   | str    | Path to the pickle file.                                         | _required_                |
| dir_config | str    | Path to the configuration file, default "./config/default.json". | `'./config/default.json'` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                     |
|--------|--------------|---------------------------------|
|        | CarbonTracer | The loaded CarbonTracer object. |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

```python
tracer = read_pickle('tracer.pkl', dir_config="./config/default.json")
```
